hooks.command: summary=$(bin/lint-skills.py 2>&1 | tail -1); jq -nc --arg s "$summary" '{systemMessage: ("D&W Skill Linter: " + $s)}'
output=$(bin/lint-skills.py --errors-only 2>&1) || jq -nc --arg out "$output" '{decision: "block", reason: ("Skill-pattern linter found errors. Fix before stopping:\n\n" + $out)}'
